description: We are Informatics Engineering and Information Systems & Technology students from Institut Teknologi Bandung (ITB). We like turning real planetary data into dependable software: routing, geospatial processing, web apps and testing. We are building ARES Path, a safety-first route planner for astronauts at Jezero Crater, Mars. We are looking for teammates with GIS or remote sensing, UX design, or planetary science and geology knowledge. Curious beginners are welcome too!
